title: MEnRus
description: Fixes Russian-to-English keyboard layout mistakes in commands
body:
MEnRus - Dead simple and lightweight commands language autoswitch plugin.

Imagine you forgot to change the keyboard layout... Well, now you can still execute the command!

### Demo:
![enrus1](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4a265124-c07c-4cdf-8f02-ee342ebb424c)

![enrus2](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/76392142-f54b-414e-8559-1e35f37abb56)


### Description
Menrus recognizes occasional chat messages in russian that suppose to be a command and therefore **executes** them. Instantly becomes usable by all players on the server, without any permissions.

> ".рщьу" -> "/home"
> 
> "/рудз" -> "/help"
> 
> ".spawn" -> "/spawn"

### Permissions & commands
`menrus.admin` 
> /menrus reload
> 
> /menrus version 

*You can setup permission message in the* **config.yml**

*Tested on* **Bukkit**, **Spigot**, **Paper**, **Purpur**. The plugin is designed to only do its thing, therefore it doesn't have any stats or update checks. Feel Free to use ^^

Go to [GitHub](https://github.com/Zeroxeron/Menrus) for older versions and additional info!
